top_findings.title: Fuzzy team resolution silently maps unknown teams to unrelated clubs
top_findings.evidence: soccer_mcp/queries.py:45-47 — difflib.get_close_matches(cutoff=0.6) with no ambiguity check. Verified: _resolve_team(store,'Real Madrid') -> 'real garcilaso'; _resolve_team(store,'Atletico') -> 'atletico es' (not Atletico Mineiro/Paranaense); _resolve_team(store,'America') -> 'americano'. Every team-scoped tool (search_matches, team_stats, head_to_head, biggest_wins) then returns confidently wrong data instead of the QueryError on line 48.
top_findings.suggestion: Raise QueryError when the best match's ratio is below a stricter cutoff (~0.85), or when the top-2 candidates are within a small delta, and return the candidate list as a disambiguation prompt.
